title: screens-intake: consolidate its requirements file under the cap

status.reason: reopened: Found mark from screens-intake-rounds (PR 888, 7 Nov): R73 for a file over the request ceiling. A 120 MB PDF goes through sendInParts; the real captureuploadbegin refuses it TOO_LARGE with its size and the 100 MB limit, but sendInParts' ended path draws it through refusalHtml as the bare refusal.TOO_LARGE (the address sentence: no figures, no toolarge.nothing_read, no ways in). Draw the DEC-500 too-large refusal there exactly as for a single upload (screen.capture.refusal.toolarge.{size,...}, then toolarge.nothing_read, then R74 ways in), with a through-the-screen test on the parted path. Then screens-intake-rounds strikes its R73 todo.
